verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents AI features like K:AI/Composer generating audiences, content, and send strategy, an AI-powered subject line generator, and a Customer Agent that surfaces order info—these are AI-generated suggestions inside the product. However, evidence is thin on data-driven 'insights' (analytics-based recommendations) specifically, mostly focused on content/campaign generation rather than deep data analysis insights. Missing for 10: concrete examples of insight/analytics-style suggestions (e.g., anomaly detection, churn prediction, performance insights), and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor marketing copy.
